items.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Co Hosts Sovereign AI Defense Summit
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) co hosted the Ondas Defense Technology Summit focused on sovereign AI for mission critical defense. The summit brought together defense officials and industry partners to review AI use directly in national security workflows. items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalantir stock fell 25% in the past month, even though third-quarter revenue grew 96% and the company raised its full-year guidance. Slower bookings, worries about the Pentagon budget under a Democratic Congress, and Anthropic’s IPO gave investors reasons to pay less, while Datadog fell even further in the same AI software selloff.
